items.title: David Weinstein Interview, 1988-09-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...like Lelke. And you know, I can't figure out how to spell.

ctx.x: Thank God we got somebody to spell. These names are really hard, like Lelke. And you know, I can't figure out how to spell. Marcel German, how was it German?
Oh, he was a cellist. G-U-E-R-M-A-N-N. G-U-E-R. G-U-E-R. He was Flemish, I think. Either Flemish or pure Belgian, whatever it is. He was a nut.
